overview: A political campaign dashboard covering all electorates of Papua New Guinea, with a national overview, searchable electorate directory, per-electorate profiles, and campaign activity tracking.
features: National overview with totals and charts by province and support level
Searchable, filterable directory of all PNG electorates
Per-electorate profile with campaign status and activity log
Record campaign events, contacts, and notes
Set and update support levels for each electorate
Admin-protected editing with public read-only browsing
